messages:
elaine_pm: Heads-up — Legal flagged EU customer contracts for the upcoming model swap. They want an explicit opt-in for any private/dedicated cutover. Can we discuss how that affects rollout windows and ownership?

sam_eng: rough impact: we can still do staged canaries on hosted, but dedicated/private customers would need a gated cutover. means per-tenant flag + manual handoff.
dmitri_sre: agree with sam. Also need telemetry gates before we flip a tenant. Latency/p99 and error-rate baselines must be green for 30m.
jia_prodops: proposed contract flow: customer signs opt-in -> PM toggles tenant flag in console -> ops schedules a warm window -> if telemetry passes, schedule cutover in maintenance window.
elaine_pm: sounds good. question: do we force an automated rollback if metrics deviate, or make it a manual ops decision?
dmitri_sre: automated rollback for severe signals (error-rate > 3x baseline or p50 spike > 2x) — otherwise alert to oncall for manual revert. We can codify thresholds.
sam_eng: implementation notes: per-tenant flag already exists, but we need a tiny front-end flow for "customer opt-in verified" and an API hook for prodops to schedule the cutover window. ETA: ~3 sprints for end-to-end (ui + api + runbook).
jia_prodops: also need a hotfix window post-cutover: 2 hours immediate watch, then 24h soft-monitoring. We'll coordinate ops rotation.
ops-bot: Reminder: add calendar entry for maintenance window and include oncall pager duty. (automated)
elaine_pm: Decision for this thread: 1) require written opt-in for private/dedicated cutovers, 2) implement telemetry gates + automated rollback for severe signals, 3) prodops to own scheduling and hotfix watch. Anyone object?
sam_eng: no objections. we'll scope API + small UI for opt-in flag.
dmitri_sre: no objections. I'll draft the thresholds and the runbook.
jia_prodops: no objections. I'll own the scheduling flow and calendar automation.
elaine_pm: Next steps: sam to create a lightweight spec and link prototype, dmitri to post runbook draft, jia to add calendar automation tasks. Weekly check-in Friday.
sam_eng: creating spec now — link: https://redwood.internal/notes/rollout-optin-spec (draft).
dmitri_sre: runbook draft posted in Confluence, will ping once updated.
elaine_pm: thanks all. Closing this thread — follow-ups in the spec and runbook threads. :white_check_mark:
